dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Good luck to you.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Someday, I'll invite Flora to board a dandelion boat that I built by my own hand... It's just such a shame that my last few attempts all sank on the maiden voyage...

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: ...But every cloud has a silver lining. My swimming ability has improved greatly as a result!

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Last time, I even had several crabs grab onto my eyelids. But I still managed to swim back to shore, even though I couldn't see.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Oh, and several more ended up in my pockets too... Here, you can have them. Now, I have a boat to build!

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: What do you want? Are you here to jeer and ridicule me too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Whoa, I haven't said anything yet...

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Well, what is it then? I highly doubt you're here to help me build my boat.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Anyway, whatever it is I'm not in the mood for it now. *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it...

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Hmph. Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about Flora...

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: You must want to know why I'm so nice to Flora?

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Well... it's like this. My parents separated when I was very young, and I spent much of my childhood on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: I sometimes imagined what it would be like to have a sibling, and the way I imagined them is exactly how Flora is: light-hearted, bubbly, and carefree...

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: So, I just want to treat her like I would my own sibling, you know, do nice things for her.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: It sounds stupid, I know, but I always wanted to go boating together as a family. My old man practically laughs till he cries whenever I mention it to him, though... Tsk, that old cynic...

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: But I'm sure that Flora wouldn't laugh at me like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hehe, uh-huh! You're probably right.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: ...Hey, don't do impressions of Flora! It's disrespectful!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems mildly self-indulgent of you.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Right, exactly...

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: ...Wait, what? No! Self-indulgent? No, no, it's not like that!

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: You have to have some degree of admiration for your own goals, don't you? Otherwise, why would you pursue them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...You're building a boat?

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: Yes. Just a little one, so I can take Flora out on the lake.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: I thought that with Flora being so light and dainty, no boat would be fit for her unless I got rid of the keel, which is heavy and unwieldy.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: I also figured I'd build the hull from her favorite thing in the world — dandelions!

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: ...What? You want to see the boat?

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: My first attempt is on the lake bed over there, and the second one is on the lake bed right here.

dialogues.speaker: Ulfr
dialogues.text: I just don't understand why they won't float.
